title: 집주인에게 전화하기: 보일러가 고장 났어요
objective: Say what is broken and politely ask for help with -어 주세요 and -어 주실 수 있어요?
summary: A tenant calls the landlord to report a broken boiler.
setting: A phone call. Mark lives in a rented one-room apartment. His boiler stopped working, so he calls his landlord.

task.title: Report and request repairs
task.line: Read each item and choose, complete, match, or reorder the Korean as the instructions say.

words.meaning: to break down, to stop working (machines)

words.exampleMeaning: Water is leaking from the ceiling.

words.meaning: to be clogged, to be blocked
(a light) to go out, to burn out
words.exampleMeaning: The room light went out, so it's dark.
What time is the repair technician coming?

words.meaning: Please do ... (for me). Asks someone to do something for you.
words.exampleMeaning: Please open the door for me.

words.meaning: Could you please ...? (softer and more polite than -어 주세요)
words.exampleMeaning: Could you come on the weekend?

dialogue.meaning: Hello, sir. This is Mark from unit 302.

dialogue.korean: 어제부터 보일러가 고장 났어요. 뜨거운 물이 안 나와요.
dialogue.meaning: The boiler has been broken since yesterday. There's no hot water.

dialogue.korean: 내일 오전에 수리 기사님이 갈 거예요. 집에 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: A repair technician will go tomorrow morning. Will you be home?

dialogue.korean: 내일 오전에는 회사에 있어요. 저녁 7시 이후에 와 주실 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I'll be at work tomorrow morning. Could they come after 7 p.m.?
Sure, then I'll change the time to 7.

dialogue.korean: 감사합니다. 그리고 화장실 전등도 나갔어요. 그것도 봐 주실 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Thank you. Also, the bathroom light has gone out. Could you have that checked too?

exercises: Choose the right word: 부엌 싱크대가 (막혀서 / 나가서) 물이 안 내려가요.
Fill in the blank with the -어 주세요 form of the verb in brackets: 에어컨이 고장 났어요. 빨리 ____ (고치다).
Fill in the blank with the -어 주실 수 있어요? form of the verb in brackets: 지금은 좀 바빠요. 내일 다시 ____ (전화하다)
Match each situation to the problem (a 전등이 나갔어요 / b 물이 새요 / c 변기가 막혔어요): ① 방이 너무 어두워요. ② 바닥에 물이 계속 생겨요. ③ 화장실 물이 안 내려가요.
Put the words in order to make a polite request: 와 / 토요일에 / 주실 수 있어요? / 수리 기사님이
answers: ① a ② b ③ c
토요일에 수리 기사님이 와 주실 수 있어요? (수리 기사님이 토요일에 와 주실 수 있어요?)
